name: Druid of the Claw
objectiveText: Oben Rageclaw wants you to kill his soulless body, and then use the Voodoo Charm .   Release Oben Rageclaw's spirit  ( 1 )

comments.body: he is in bear form  you have to kill rage claw the bear and then use the voodoo charm once he is dead

proceed to Ban'ethil Barrow Den.
coordinates: 43,58.
in there you will find a Rageclaw. kill him and use the Voodoo Charm.

His spirit was walking around in a circle in human/druid form.  When I attacked, he changed into the bear form.  The first time I tried to use the claw on him, it didn't work (must not have been holding my mouth right).  2nd time - VOILA!

I still shudder at the memory of the very first toon I did these quests with - if you're low level, you really need a group because the gnarlpines do respawn very quickly.  Plus the caves and paths all looked the same to me (heh heh). 

This time with my rogue it was much easier and maybe because of more cave experience, not as confusing to get around. 

Good luck to all!
He's pretty easy to beat and it doesn't even matter if you are the one who kills him, you just have to use the charm on the corpse.

comments.body:
I am lvl 14 now...and came back to finish this quest. No prob finding the druid bear, and killed him, used voodoo thing on him, but after the bar went to full, it said 'invalid target'.

Not sure what's up with that, but I hung around and killed him three times, did not loot, right clicked on voodoo thing, waited while the progress bar did it's thing. Same message "failed. Invalid target" Anyone else have this problem?
replies:
I had this problem too. You are right clicking (to use) the charm, and then clicking the hand on the body. That doesn't work.

Instead, select the corpse first. Then right click the charm. That will fix your problem.

there is the purple and gold Raven Claw talisman. That is the wrong one. There is the Voodoo charm. That should be the right one. 

Auto loot may interfere with selecting the body.

Sean

By the time you get to this quest (meaning after getting the voodoo charm) it's easy as pie, and just an afterthought.  Rageclaw is an average level 10 at best, and doesn't run away like most of the other mobs in the den.  He's often in a crowded area, so if you don't have friends, be prepared to deal with more than one baddy.
